Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an agricultural scenic corridor within the scenic and recreational highway system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an agricultural scenic corridor withinthe scenic and recreational highway system; and amending RCW 47.39.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:
